01 / How it works

Look before you flash.

Pick your phone

Search by name, model number or codename. Every model lists each system it can run, so you never have to guess what fits.

Compare the options

Read what sets each system apart, see the build behind it, and check whether it has been tested on your exact model.

Choose a verified build

Prefer verified builds when you can. Back up your data first, and treat anything untested as experimental.

Back up your data first: switching to a different operating system can erase everything on your phone. Copy your photos, messages, contacts and app data somewhere safe before you start, and check that the backup opens.

02 / Systems

The lineup, by boot screen.

From polished manufacturer skins to privacy-first community ROMs. Open any one for features, supported devices and verified builds.

03 / Devices

Find your phone.

Every supported model in one list. Each dot is a system you can run; a ring around a dot means that build is verified.
